ObsGetConnectionByName.description: Finds the number of an OBS connection by its name, as shown on the OBS page. The first connection is 0. Capital letters do not matter.
ObsGetConnectionByName.returns: The connection number, or -1 when no connection has that name.
ObsGetConnectionByName.example:
int studio = CPH.ObsGetConnectionByName("Studio PC");
CPH.LogInfo($"Studio PC is connection {studio}");

ObsConnect.description: Checks whether OBS is connected. Cuebot connects (and reconnects) OBS by itself, so this does not start a connection.
ObsConnect.returns: true when OBS is connected, otherwise false.

ObsDisconnect.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot keeps its OBS connections open. It only writes a warning in the log. Disconnect OBS on the OBS page instead.

ObsPauseRecording.description: Pauses the OBS recording. Gives an error when OBS is not connected.

ObsResumeRecording.description: Carries on with a paused OBS recording. Gives an error when OBS is not connected.

ObsReplayBufferStart.description: Starts the OBS replay buffer, which keeps the last few seconds of your stream ready to save. Gives an error when OBS is not connected.

ObsReplayBufferStop.description: Stops the OBS replay buffer. Gives an error when OBS is not connected.

ObsReplayBufferSave.description: Saves the replay buffer to a file, so you keep the last few seconds of your stream. The replay buffer must be running in OBS.

ObsSetReplayBufferState.description: Starts, stops or saves the OBS replay buffer with a number: 0 starts it, 1 stops it, 2 saves it. Any other number gives an error.

ObsMediaPlay.description: Plays a media source (a video or sound file in OBS). The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the source by its name.

ObsMediaPause.description: Pauses a media source (a video or sound file in OBS). The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the source by its name.

ObsMediaRestart.description: Starts a media source again from the beginning. The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the source by its name.

ObsMediaStop.description: Stops a media source (a video or sound file in OBS). The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the source by its name.

ObsMediaNext.description: Skips to the next file in a media source that plays a list (like a VLC playlist source).

ObsMediaPrevious.description: Goes back to the previous file in a media source that plays a list (like a VLC playlist source).

ObsSetMediaState.description: Controls a media source with a number: 0 play, 1 pause, 2 restart, 3 stop, 4 next, 5 previous. Any other number gives an error.

ObsSourceMute.description: Mutes an audio source in OBS, like your microphone. The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the source by its name.

ObsSourceUnMute.description: Unmutes an audio source in OBS, like your microphone. The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the source by its name.

ObsSourceMuteToggle.description: Mutes an audio source when it is on, or unmutes it when it is muted.

ObsSetSourceMuteState.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio source with a number: 0 mutes, 1 unmutes, 2 switches it. Any other number gives an error.

ObsSetSceneFilterState.description: Turns a filter on a scene itself on or off with a number: 0 on, 1 off, 2 switches it.

ObsSetSourceFilterState.description: Turns a filter on a source on or off with a number: 0 on, 1 off, 2 switches it. The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the source by its name.

ObsHideGroupsSources.description: Hides every source inside an OBS group. The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the group by its name.

ObsHideSceneSources.description: Hides every source in a scene.

ObsSetRandomGroupSourceVisible.description: Shows one random source inside an OBS group and hides the others. Fun for a random hat or sticker. The scene is not needed.
ObsSetRandomGroupSourceVisible.returns: The name of the source it showed, or empty text when the group has no sources.

ObsSetRandomSceneSourceVisible.description: Shows one random source in a scene and hides the others.
ObsSetRandomSceneSourceVisible.returns: The name of the source it showed, or empty text when the scene has no sources.

ObsGetGroupSources.description: Lists the sources inside an OBS group, top first. The scene is not needed, because OBS finds the group by its name.
ObsGetGroupSources.returns: A list with the names of the group's sources.

ObsSetColorSourceColor.description: Changes the colour of a colour source. Give the colour as text like "#FF0000" (red) or "#80FF0000" (see-through red), or as four numbers 0-255: alpha (see-through), red, green, blue.

ObsSetColorSourceRandomColor.description: Gives a colour source a random colour. The colour is never see-through.

ObsConvertColorHex.description: Turns a colour like "#FF0000" or "#80FF0000" (the # is optional) into the colour number OBS uses. Text that is not a colour gives an error.
ObsConvertColorHex.example:
long red = CPH.ObsConvertColorHex("#FF0000");
CPH.LogInfo($"OBS colour number: {red}");

ObsConvertRgb.description: Turns alpha (see-through), red, green and blue (each 0-255) into the colour number OBS uses. Numbers outside 0-255 are cut to fit.
ObsConvertRgb.example:
long purple = CPH.ObsConvertRgb(255, 145, 70, 255);
CPH.LogInfo($"OBS colour number: {purple}");

ObsTakeScreenshot.description: Saves a picture of a source or scene to a file. Leave the source empty for what is on stream. The file ending (.png, .jpg) sets the format. Quality is 0-100, or -1 for OBS's default.
ObsTakeScreenshot.returns: true when the picture was saved, false when it failed (a warning goes in the log).

ObsGetSceneItemProperties.description: Reads the details of a source in a scene, like its position, size, whether it is visible or locked. Uses the same names as the "Get Scene Item Properties" sub-action.
ObsGetSceneItemProperties.returns: The details as text in JSON format, or "{}" when there are none.

ObsSendBatchRaw.description: Sends several raw OBS requests at once, for advanced users. The data is a JSON list of {requestType, requestData}. Cuebot always runs them in order. haltOnFailure stops at the first one that fails.
ObsSendBatchRaw.returns: The answers from OBS as text in JSON format.

SlobsIsConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Streamlabs Desktop. Cuebot has one Streamlabs Desktop connection, number 0.
SlobsIsConnected.returns: true when it is connected, otherwise false (also for any connection number other than 0).
SlobsIsConnected.example:
bool ready = CPH.SlobsIsConnected();
CPH.LogInfo($"Streamlabs Desktop connected: {ready}");

SlobsConnect.description: Checks whether Streamlabs Desktop is connected. Cuebot connects (and reconnects) it by itself, so this does not start a connection.
SlobsConnect.returns: true when it is connected, otherwise false.
SlobsConnect.example:
bool ready = CPH.SlobsConnect();
CPH.LogInfo($"Streamlabs Desktop connected: {ready}");

SlobsDisconnect.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Cuebot keeps the Streamlabs Desktop connection open. It only writes a warning in the log. Disconnect it on its page instead.

SlobsSetScene.description: Switches Streamlabs Desktop to another scene.
SlobsSetScene.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsGetCurrentScene.description: Finds out which scene Streamlabs Desktop is showing right now.
SlobsGetCurrentScene.returns: The scene's name, or empty text when Streamlabs Desktop is not connected.

SlobsStartStreaming.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsStopStreaming.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsStartRecording.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsStopRecording.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsPauseRecording.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Streamlabs Desktop cannot pause a recording from outside. It only writes a warning in the log.

SlobsResumeRecording.description: Not supported in Cuebot: Streamlabs Desktop cannot pause or resume a recording from outside. It only writes a warning in the log.

SlobsIsStreaming.description: Checks whether Streamlabs Desktop is live right now.
SlobsIsStreaming.returns: true while it is streaming, otherwise false. Also false when Streamlabs Desktop is not connected.

SlobsIsRecording.description: Checks whether Streamlabs Desktop is recording right now.
SlobsIsRecording.returns: true while it is recording, otherwise false. Also false when Streamlabs Desktop is not connected.

SlobsSetSourceVisibility.description: Shows (true) or hides (false) a source in a Streamlabs Desktop scene. The form with an output (horizontal or vertical) works the same: Cuebot ignores the output.
SlobsSetSourceVisibility.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSetSourceVisibilityState.description: Shows or hides a source in a Streamlabs Desktop scene with a number: 0 shows it, 1 hides it, 2 switches it. The output setting is ignored.
SlobsSetSourceVisibilityState.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsShowSource.description: Shows a source in a Streamlabs Desktop scene. The form with an output (horizontal or vertical) works the same: Cuebot ignores the output.
SlobsShowSource.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsHideSource.description: Hides a source in a Streamlabs Desktop scene. The form with an output (horizontal or vertical) works the same: Cuebot ignores the output.
SlobsHideSource.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsIsSourceVisible.description: Checks whether a source in a Streamlabs Desktop scene is showing. The output setting is ignored.
SlobsIsSourceVisible.returns: true when the source is visible, false when it is hidden or not found. Also false when Streamlabs Desktop is not connected.

SlobsGetGroupSources.description: Lists the sources inside a Streamlabs Desktop folder (group) in a scene.
SlobsGetGroupSources.returns: A list with the names of the sources, or an empty list when the folder is not found. Empty when Streamlabs Desktop is not connected.

SlobsHideGroupsSources.description: Hides every source inside a Streamlabs Desktop folder (group). The output setting is ignored.
SlobsHideGroupsSources.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSetRandomGroupSourceVisible.description: Shows one random source inside a Streamlabs Desktop folder (group) and hides the others. The output setting is ignored.
SlobsSetRandomGroupSourceVisible.returns: The name of the source it showed, or empty text when there is none. Empty when Streamlabs Desktop is not connected.

SlobsSetGdiText.description: Changes the words in a Streamlabs Desktop text source. The scene is not needed.
SlobsSetGdiText.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSetBrowserSource.description: Changes the web address a Streamlabs Desktop browser source shows. The scene is not needed.
SlobsSetBrowserSource.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSourceMute.description: Mutes an audio source in Streamlabs Desktop, like your microphone. The scene and the third text (filterName) are not used; you can leave the third one empty.
SlobsSourceMute.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSourceUnMute.description: Unmutes an audio source in Streamlabs Desktop. The scene and the third text (filterName) are not used; you can leave the third one empty.
SlobsSourceUnMute.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSourceMuteToggle.description: Mutes an audio source in Streamlabs Desktop when it is on, or unmutes it when it is muted. The scene and the third text are not used.
SlobsSourceMuteToggle.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSetSourceMuteState.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio source in Streamlabs Desktop with a number: 0 mutes, 1 unmutes, 2 switches it. Any other number gives an error.
SlobsSetSourceMuteState.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsShowFilter.description: Turns on a filter in Streamlabs Desktop. With a scene and a filter it changes the scene's own filter; with a scene, a source and a filter it changes the source's filter.
SlobsShowFilter.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsHideFilter.description: Turns off a filter in Streamlabs Desktop. With a scene and a filter it changes the scene's own filter; with a scene, a source and a filter it changes the source's filter.
SlobsHideFilter.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsToggleFilter.description: Switches a filter in Streamlabs Desktop on or off. With a scene and a filter it changes the scene's own filter; with a scene, a source and a filter, the source's filter.
SlobsToggleFilter.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSetFilterState.description: Turns a Streamlabs Desktop filter on or off with a number: 0 on, 1 off, 2 switches it. Give a source too to change the source's filter instead of the scene's own.
SlobsSetFilterState.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsSetRandomFilterState.description: Picks one random filter and sets it with a number: 0 on, 1 off, 2 switches it. With only a scene it picks from the scene's own filters; with a source, from that source's.
SlobsSetRandomFilterState.returns: Nothing. When Streamlabs Desktop is not connected, it does nothing and writes a warning in the log.

SlobsIsFilterEnabled.description: Checks whether a Streamlabs Desktop filter is on. With a scene and a filter it checks the scene's own filter; with a scene, a source and a filter, the source's filter.
SlobsIsFilterEnabled.returns: true when the filter is on, false when it is off or not found. Also false when Streamlabs Desktop is not connected.
